{"metadata":{"description":"蓝毛小女仆 (Blue-Haired Little Maid) · 住在 Windows 桌面上的 Q 版蓝发小女仆桌面宠物：106 个手绘透明动画、本地 Ollama 或在线模型陪聊、可选看屏幕吐槽、离线语音识别（安装器与便携版）。免费开源 MIT。同时是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物插件（dsh-plugin）。By Mikolu.","id":"gh:1409724830","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"cute-fat-fish-pet","slug":"12we21/cute-fat-fish-pet","topics":["ai","chinese","deepseek-harness","desktop-pet","dsh","dsh-plugin","electron","llm","ollama","speech-recognition","tamagotchi","tts","virtual-pet","windows","windows-desktop"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"蓝毛小女仆 (Blue-Haired Little Maid) · 住在 Windows 桌面上的 Q 版蓝发小女仆桌面宠物：106 个手绘透明动画、本地 Ollama 或在线模型陪聊、可选看屏幕吐槽"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"、离线语音识别（安装器与便携版）。免费开源 MIT。同时是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物插件（dsh-plugin）。By Mikolu."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 蓝毛小女仆 · Blue-Haired Little Maid"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A free, open-source desktop pet for Windows: a transparent little maid who lives on your desktop.*"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"*A free, open-source desktop pet for Windows: a transparent little maid who lives on your desktop.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"She idles, wanders around and does little animations on her own. She can chat with you, take a look "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"at your screen and say something about it — and when you ask her to, she can open an app, a file, a "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"folder or a web page for you, or start a screen recording."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Install · First run · Data & privacy · Build from source · Verify your download · License"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**English** · 中文文档"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## About this project"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**蓝毛小女仆 (Blue-Haired Little Maid)** is an independent desktop-pet project, developed and maintained "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Haired Little Maid)** is an independent desktop-pet project, developed and maintained by **Mikolu**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Special thanks to **PC2005-cloud**, whose **dsh-pet 0.3.0** provided the early foundation and the in"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"spiration for this project."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The pet engine in `src/` is that codebase, carried forward and maintained in-tree: of the 243 files "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"in the published upstream `dsh-pet@0.3.0` package, **232 are byte-identical here and 11 were changed"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" on purpose** (each one listed with sizes and reasons in docs/differences-from-upstream.md), **no up"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"stream file was dropped**, and three engine files (`runtime/electron-helper/obs-ctl.js`, `stt-worker"},{"id":"p10s5","text":".mjs`, `targets.js`) are ours. Everything else in this repository — the console, the standalone runn"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"er, the build chain, the installer, the docs — is this project's own work."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"There is no patching step any more: `src/` **is** the shipped source. Building is just laying the so"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"urce tree out in release shape and adding the runtimes that are not kept in git."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Product name | **蓝毛小女仆** (Blue-Haired Little Maid) |
| Repository / package / installer name | `cu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"te-fat-fish-pet` — legacy display name "Cute Fat Fish Pet" / 「可爱大肥鱼桌宠」 |
| Author / maintainer | Mik"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"olu |
| Version | 1.2.4 |
| License | MIT — see LICENSE |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What she can do"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **She moves on her own** — 106 hand-drawn transparent animations (VP9-alpha webm, composited onto "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"your wallpaper with a screen blend). Idle breathing, looking around, walking to random spots, random"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" small gestures. Animation weights and frequency are configurable.
- **She talks with you** — click "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"her to open the chat. Local models through Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the console has"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" three modes: **Local**, **Auto (best available)** and **Online**.
- **She can watch your screen** ("},{"id":"p15s6","text":"optional, switchable) — a screenshot every so often is handed to a vision model and she comments on "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"it. With no vision model configured this path stays off instead of sending a random image.
- **She m"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"utters and speaks up** — she fills quiet moments on her own, and can be driven by work state (task s"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"tarted / finished / failed).
- **She can do things for you (your call)** — open an app, a file, a fo"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"lder or a URL; screen recording goes to OBS or to whatever software you pick, saved wherever you pic"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"k. Three permission switches turn this off completely.
- **Voice** — speech input runs fully offline"},{"id":"p15s12","text":" inside the package (sherpa-onnx + SenseVoice int8); her voice uses Edge TTS + SSML, with adjustable"},{"id":"p15s13","text":" rate and pitch (the pitch is stored in the data root).
- **One single-HTML console** — start / stop"},{"id":"p15s14","text":", status, models and "AI brain", voice, permissions, recording, logs: all in one window, no command "},{"id":"p15s15","text":"line.
- **Persona and memory** — persona files, chat history and screen-watch state live in the data"},{"id":"p15s16","text":" root; you can edit them and back the whole thing up."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What she does on first run"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"You do not have to configure anything. On the first start she does a "local fit" round:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. **Looks at your GPU** — reads the VRAM size from the registry to decide the model context size an"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"d when to unload it (the result is written to `device-profile.json`).
2. **Finds local models** — li"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"sts the models already pulled into Ollama and picks one as the chat model, plus a vision model for s"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"creen watching if there is one.
3. **Seeds the defaults** — copies the bundled default persona / ani"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"mation config / screen-watch config into the data root. **Only missing files are added; files you ed"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ited are never overwritten.**
4. **Writes a run record** — `runtime.json` (pid, port, model, start t"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"ime), removed on exit; it is the first place to look when she does not come up."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"She also runs with **no model at all**: she will idle, wander and gesture, she just will not speak. "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"To give her a voice, install Ollama and pull a model, or fill in an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (base"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" URL + key + model name) under **模型 · AI 大脑 → 联网模型** in the console."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Data & privacy"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Privacy"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Screen watching** is **a local screenshot handed to the model you chose**. Pick a local Ollama m"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"odel and nothing leaves your machine; pick an online model and the image goes to the endpoint you co"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"nfigured. Turn it off in the console and no screenshot is taken at all.
- **Speech recognition runs "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"offline**: sherpa-onnx + SenseVoice int8 are inside the package and need no network.
- **Edge TTS ne"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"eds the network** (it uses Microsoft's online speech synthesis).
- **Online model API keys are store"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"d in plain text** in `standalone\online.json` (in the program directory). It is a local file meant f"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"or you only — do not send this file to anyone, and do not upload a directory that contains it.
- **S"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"he never phones home**: no telemetry, no usage reporting. Only the online features you turn on (onli"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ne models, Edge TTS) use the network.
- Uninstalling keeps your data; delete `online.json` and the d"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"ata root yourself if you want them gone."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"More detail, including the local control-bridge hardening added in 1.1.0, is in SECURITY.md."}],"truncated":true}
